about.intro: 我是亓炳堃，一名国际学校理科教师，教授物理、数学与高等数学。
paragraphs: 我的学习与研究经历跨越复旦大学、纽约市立大学、北京大学和洛桑联邦理工学院，研究兴趣集中在非厄米光子学。我也已获得亚利桑那州立大学的 Master of Engineering, Computing and Technology 学位。
从物理研究到课堂教学，我一直喜欢把复杂问题拆解成可以理解、可以尝试的步骤。现在，我也在探索用 AI 辅助开发教学工具，将备课中的具体需求做成可使用的题库与练习网站。
teaching: 国际学校物理、数学与高等数学教学
纽约市立大学本科物理讲授与实验教学经历
洛桑联邦理工学院助教经历
life: 骑行：在路上发现新的风景
健身：保持运动与日常节奏
音乐：给专注之外留一点空间

projects.title: CAIE 9702 AS Physics 题库
projects.kicker: 3,232 道 AS 试题 · 物理教学工具
projects.summary: 从日常备课需求出发，将试题筛选、选题篮、组卷与打印设置集中在同一个网站。
features: AS 阶段共 3,232 道题，核对日期为 2026 年 10 月 22 日
按阶段、试卷、主题、子主题与考试季筛选
使用选题篮整理候选试题
提供目标分值组卷与智能组卷界面
配置答案显示与打印选项
story: 备课时，我经常需要围绕一个知识点寻找适合课堂与练习的题目。这个项目从这样的具体需求出发，把筛选条件、候选题目与组卷设置放在一起。
我尤其关注 AS 物理教学中的选题过程：从主题与子主题逐步缩小范围，再通过选题篮组织练习。它也是我探索 AI 辅助开发教学工具的一次实践。

projects.title: 学生反馈与教务系统
projects.kicker: 教学管理 · 教师与学生
projects.summary: 连接教师与学生的反馈入口，探索将教学沟通与日常管理放进同一个系统。
features: 教师与学生分别登录使用
支持中文与 English 界面
围绕学生反馈与教务管理场景设计
story: 教学工具也可以帮助课堂之外的工作。这个系统围绕学生反馈与日常教务管理展开，提供教师与学生各自的使用入口。
我希望把教学中的沟通需求做成清晰、易用的流程。它与题库项目一起，构成我对 AI 辅助软件开发在教育场景中应用的探索。

features: 对应 Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics B（4MB1）
收录 1,099 道题
覆盖 58 套试卷
story: 数学教学同样需要持续积累与整理练习资源。我围绕 Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics B 建立了这个题库，把分散在试卷中的题目汇集起来。
对我来说，开发的起点始终是课堂中的具体问题。我希望这些资源能为备课与练习安排提供更顺手的入口。

我把这些项目看作教学与技术之间的连接：先发现课堂中的需求，再尝试把想法做成可使用的工具。

about.intro: I'm Bingkun Qi, a science teacher at an international school, teaching physics, mathematics and advanced mathematics.
paragraphs: My studies and research have taken me to Fudan University, CUNY, Peking University and EPFL, with a research focus on non-Hermitian photonics. I also hold a Master of Engineering, Computing and Technology from Arizona State University.

From physics research to the classroom, I enjoy breaking complex problems into steps that people can understand and explore. I am also experimenting with AI-assisted development, turning everyday teaching needs into question banks and practice websites.
teaching: Physics, mathematics and advanced mathematics in an international school
Undergraduate physics lecture and laboratory teaching at CUNY
life: Cycling: finding new views along the way
Fitness: making movement part of everyday life
Music: leaving room to pause and listen

projects.title: CAIE 9702 AS Physics Question Bank
projects.summary: Built around everyday lesson preparation, bringing question filters, a selection basket, paper assembly and print settings into one website.
features: 3,232 AS questions, checked on 22 October 2026
Filter by stage, paper, topic, subtopic and exam session
Collect candidate questions in a basket
Interfaces for target-score and smart paper assembly
Configurable answer display and print options
story: When preparing lessons, I often need to find questions that fit a particular concept and classroom activity. This project grew from that practical need, bringing filters, selected questions and paper settings together.

My focus is the process of choosing questions for AS physics: narrowing down by topic and subtopic, then using a basket to organise practice. It is also an experiment in using AI-assisted development to build teaching tools.

projects.title: Student Feedback & Teaching Administration
projects.summary: A shared starting point for teachers and students, exploring how software can support feedback and everyday teaching administration.
features: Separate teacher and student sign-in flows
Chinese and English interfaces
Designed around student feedback and teaching administration
story: Useful teaching tools can also support the work around a lesson. This project focuses on student feedback and everyday administration, with dedicated entry points for teachers and students.
My aim is to turn communication needs into clear, usable workflows. Alongside the question banks, it forms part of my exploration of AI-assisted software development for education.

projects.title: Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics B Question Bank

features: Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics B (4MB1)
1,099 questions
58 papers
story: Teaching mathematics also involves steadily collecting and organising practice resources. I built this question bank around Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics B to bring questions from different papers together.
For me, development starts with a concrete classroom need. My aim is to make these resources easier to approach when planning lessons and practice.

projects.title: Edexcel A-Level Maths Question Bank

story: Moving from IGCSE to A-Level changes both the depth of mathematics and the practice students need. This project continues my exploration of organising teaching resources online, with a focus on Edexcel A-Level mathematics.
I see these projects as a connection between teaching and technology: identify a classroom need, then try to turn the idea into a usable tool.

projects.title: ESAT Mock Practice

story: Alongside course question banks, I am interested in the practice needs that come with admissions tests. The ESAT mock practice project is an exploration in that direction.
My aim is to combine my experience teaching science and mathematics with tool development, giving an idea for exam preparation a practical form.
